manifest.name: dsh-deep-work
manifest.description: Deep Work — a knowledge-work mode for DeepSeek Harness: research, writing, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and verified deliverables.

bundle.text:
# Deep Work bundle layer.
#
# The first row publishes the skill pack; the second declares the selectable
# `deep-work` agent preset. The preset is assembled from the same agent-plane
# rows used by the shipped knowledge-work presets, with its own persona and
# workflow instructions.

- insert:
    - id: deep-work
      name: dsh-deep-work

    - id: preset-deep-work
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: deep-work
        name: Deep Work
        description: Research, writing, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and verified deliverables — a general knowledge-work mode.
        order: 4.5
        plugins:
          # ── identity ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: >-
                You are Deep Work, a knowledge-work agent powered by the {{model}} model.
                Your working directory is the session workspace. You turn briefs into
                finished, verified deliverables: research briefs, reports, assignments,
                analyses, Word documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, and other
                files a person can open and use.

                You are not a code agent that reluctantly writes prose. Operate as a
                careful researcher, editor, analyst, and production manager at once.
                Use the deep-work skill for the operating protocol. Read the workspace
                before asking questions. When a deliverable is substantial or likely to
                span sessions, keep the task state in .deep-work/ as the skill describes.

                Never claim work is complete until you have inspected the produced file
                or artifact. Never invent a source, quotation, statistic, or citation.
                Ask before sending, publishing, deleting, or changing anything outside
                the workspace. Prefer a real file over a promise of one.

          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536

          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'

          # ── shell ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'

          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'

          # ── filesystem ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'

          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false

          # ── background jobs ─────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'

          # ── skills and discovery ────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'

          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'

          # ── goals and planning ──────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'

          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'

          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Explore the workspace and the sources first. Do not mutate files, run formatters, or produce the deliverable while plan mode is active. Build a decision-complete plan, then submit it with exit_plan_mode. A conversational yes does not approve the plan; only exit_plan_mode approval does.

          # ── compaction ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'

              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'

              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

          # ── delegation and workflows ────────────────────────────────────
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'

              - id: tool-subagent-list-agents
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents'

              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  backgroundMode: continuable

              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
                  backgroundMode: continuable

              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn

              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'

              - id: tool-ralph
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ralph'
                config:
                  subagentProvider: spawn
                  maxRounds: 64

          # ── remaining model-facing rows ─────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'

          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true

          - id: deep-work-verify
            name: dsh-deep-work/verify

          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000

readme.text:
A knowledge-work mode for DeepSeek Harness. Deep Work turns a session into a small
delivery studio: understand the brief, make a plan, gather evidence, produce the
artifact, verify it, and hand back a file — not just a chat answer.

- assignments and essays
- research briefs and market scans
- reports and proposals
- Word documents, spreadsheets, slide decks, and PDFs
- analysis of existing files
- structured plans, SOPs, and recurring reports

- A **Deep Work** agent preset with a delivery-oriented persona.
- The **deep-work** skill, a repeatable protocol for evidence-backed knowledge work.
- A workspace task protocol under `.deep-work/` so long tasks can be resumed.
- A deliverables convention: `deliverables/` in the session workspace.
- A `verify_deliverable` tool that checks a file's existence, size, and container
  signature before the agent claims it is ready.
- Time context and scheduling tools for time-aware research and recurring reports.
- Verification rules for `.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`, `.pdf`, HTML, and data files.

Install the directory with the Harness plugin manager:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle D:\Codebase\dsh-plugins\deep-work
```

The bundle declares a `deep-work` preset. Start a new session, choose **Deep Work**
from the mode selector, select a workspace, and describe the deliverable.

A **Deep Work** cockpit is added to the right sidebar. It reads the current
session workspace and shows:

- the task objective, deliverable, status, and next step from `.deep-work/task.md`
- the checklist and progress bar from `.deep-work/plan.md`
- files in `deliverables/`, clickable into the document preview
- source count from `.deep-work/sources.md`
- working files in `.deep-work/`
- a live activity timeline from the current session's chat nodes, so the panel
  shows what is happening even before the task brief is written

The cockpit opens once when a Deep Work session begins. The small **Deep Work**
chip in the conversation header reopens it. The existing right-sidebar **Files**
tab remains available for the raw directory tree.

Examples:

> Read the notes in `notes/` and write a five-page assignment as a formatted `.docx`.
> Include a short reference list and verify the document opens.

> Analyse `sales.xlsx`, identify the three strongest trends, and produce a
> nine-slide presentation with charts and speaker notes.

> Research the market in `brief.md` and produce a report plus a one-page summary.
> Cite every factual claim and flag anything you could not verify.

For a substantial task, Deep Work keeps its working state in `.deep-work/`:

```text
.deep-work/
  task.md          # objective, constraints, state
  plan.md          # current plan
  sources.md       # source ledger and verification notes

Short requests may not need a task file. Long or multi-session requests should.

- Deep Work produces local files. It does not provide a cloud worker that
  continues after the Harness process exits.
- External side effects — sending email, publishing, paying, deleting, or sharing —
  still require the user's explicit approval.
- Web research uses the deployment's configured web providers.
- Browser automation and computer use are optional providers in Harness, not
  requirements of this plugin.
See [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md) for the test and installation record.
